messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Dedicated pool node ECC/error spike detected for customer ApertureHealth (vpc-aperture-us-east). Node gpu-az3-0 reporting repeated ECC corrections and one kernel panic. Severity: paging (P1 -> ops-assigned). Alert: https://alerts.redwood.local/ids/98765
oncall-east: oncall-east here, grabbing pager. Can someone post impact (tenant-level)?
sre-alyssa: picking up from oncall. Quick summary: node gpu-az3-0 in dedpool-aperture-01 showing ECC corrected -> escalating to uncorrectable for GPU0, then kernel OOM on `inference-worker` causing process restarts. Observed increased 5xxs for tenant model routes since 13:05 UTC. No obvious storage errors.
customer-rep-maya: Maya (CS) — I just spoke to ApertureHealth SRE. They see ~15-20% failed requests for embeddings and a few chat timeouts. Customer impact: degraded latency and errors, no data exfiltration concerns. Customer asked for isolation/fallback.
eng-runtime-leo: Suggest immediate mitigation: migrate ApertureHealth routing to dedpool-fallback-02 and pin to model-variant v1.1-robust while we drain/replace. Also can enable local KV-prefix cache to reduce token volume. Commands:
```
# move tenant to fallback pool (safe route)
redwoodctl routes set --tenant aperture --pool dedpool-fallback-02 --pin model:open-1.1-robust
# confirm current active backends
redwoodctl routes get --tenant aperture
```
infra-jordan: Jordan (infra) — hardware on-call is standing by. We can replace the GPU module but ETA ~2h for replacement window (parts + rack tech). Recommend we drain node now and shift traffic. I'll open a hardware ticket: HW-5234.
sre-alyssa: Executing node drain for tenant-scoped pods now. Will cordon and drain to avoid evicting other tenants. Running safe drain:
```
# tenant-aware drain
redwoodctl node drain --node gpu-az3-0 --tenant aperture --grace-period 60
# fallback: K8s cordon + drain (internal agent)
kubectl cordon gpu-az3-0
kubectl drain gpu-az3-0 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --timeout=5m
```
sre-alyssa: Logs while draining:
```
[13:18:12] draining pod inference-aperture-1 -> migrating cache + kv-prefix
[13:18:28] pod inference-aperture-1 terminated gracefully, started reschedule on dedpool-fallback-02
[13:19:05] streaming sessions: 24 -> 3
[13:21:10] drain complete for tenant aperture on node gpu-az3-0
```
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Drain task completed and node marked unschedulable (gpu-az3-0). HW ticket HW-5234 created by infra-jordan. Pager: closing active page for P1 to SRE team, leaving incident open for replacement.
eng-runtime-leo: Confirming model endpoints reloaded on fallback pool. Checking health: `redwoodctl metrics query --tenant aperture --metric request_errors --window 5m` -> errors dropped from 18% to 1.8% within 6m of cutover.
customer-rep-maya: Customer reports improvement: "We're seeing much fewer errors, thanks. Still observing slight latency bump but acceptable for now." They asked to be notified when replacement is complete.
infra-jordan: Replacement scheduled at 15:40 UTC. I'll coordinate with on-site tech and post patch/proc info when done. Plan: replace GPU module, run burn-in, then rejoin node as `gpu-az3-0` or reprovision as gpu-az3-0b depending on hw state. If re-provision, we'll migrate tenant back via `redwoodctl routes set`.
sre-alyssa: Leaving handoff notes for night oncall. Handoff summary: tenant impacted (ApertureHealth) — node gpu-az3-0 drained and marked unschedulable; traffic moved to dedpool-fallback-02; hardware replacement in progress (HW-5234); customer notified and seeing improvements; next steps: validate burn-in, reintroduce node only after 30m stable, run perf regression test suite `regress/tenant/aperture`.
oncall-west: Taking handoff (oncall-west). I'll watch the burn-in and confirm metrics at 15:55 UTC. Contact points: infra-jordan, sre-alyssa, eng-runtime-leo, customer-rep-maya.
sre-alyssa: Post-incident action items (quick):
- infra-jordan: track HW-5234, attach replacement logs + part serial (owner: jordan)
- eng-runtime-leo: run rollout and add a canary traffic shift back to dedpool-aperture-01 after node healthy (owner: leo)
- sre-alyssa: add probe to detect rapid ECC error spikes and automatic tenant-scope migration (owner: alyssa)
- customer-rep-maya: confirm final closure with ApertureHealth and collect any additional customer notes (owner: maya)
Please add to the postmortem if anything else pops up. :memo:
